note: Rewritten from the species description of Chhotani (1997); the original is in English, only the soldier is described, and alates and workers are recorded as unknown; distribution records, synonymy citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier body length 4.20–4.75 mm; head capsule subrectangular; frontal projection conical, its apex slightly raised and extending a little beyond the mandibular base; antennae 14-segmented; mandibles slender and rod-like, the apices incurved, slightly longer than the head; postmentum club-shaped, the waist slightly constricted; pronotum saddle-shaped. Alates and workers have not been described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; antennae, labrum, legs and body pale yellow; mandibles dark reddish brown; pilosity of head and body relatively abundant. Body length 4.20–4.75 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, length 1.18–1.20 mm, maximum width 0.88–0.91 mm; frontal projection conical, the apex upturned, extending slightly beyond the mandibular base; length from head to frontal projection 1.28–1.33 mm, frontal projection length 0.13–0.15 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of the labrum deeply concave, length 0.23–0.26 mm, width 0.23 mm. Mandibles slender and rod-like, the apices acute and incurved, slightly longer than the head; left mandible 1.25 mm long, right mandible 1.18–1.23 mm long, ratio of left mandible length to head length 1.04–1.05. Postmentum club-shaped, the waist slightly constricted, length 0.50 mm, maximum width 0.31–0.32 mm, width at the waist 0.26–0.28 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.19–0.20 mm, width 0.48–0.50 mm.
